summary: Frontend-only smoke + functional E2E test of ITcrista infoX multi-page landing site (no backend, static contact form). All 5 routes load with no console errors. Hero CTAs, animated stats, Trusted-By marquee, Services bento (26 cards across viewports incl. mobile horizontal snap slider), WhyChooseUs light section (6 features with high-contrast dark text on #F8FAFC bg), Portfolio filter (all=6 → ecommerce=2 → saas=2 filtering verified), Process desktop+mobile snap slider, Testimonials prev/next cycling through all 3 quotes (verified q1≠q2≠q3, prev reverses), Technologies dual-marquee, Pricing 3 tiers w/ growth highlight and CTA correctly navigating to /contact, FAQ accordion (data-state closed→open), Footer + social links + no broken images, Contact static form submission shows contact-success banner with NO API call. Mobile (390px) verified: hero stacks, hamburger opens a fullscreen menu listing all 5 routes + Get in Touch CTA, services-mobile-slider and process-mobile-slider both have overflowX:auto + scroll-snap-type:x mandatory and scrollWidth >> clientWidth (3880 vs 390 / 1770 vs 390). Zero console errors and zero React warnings observed across all routes.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: Mobile menu container does not expose data-testid='mobile-menu' (toggle has data-testid but the opened menu panel does not). Functionality works, but adding a testid on the menu wrapper would make E2E assertions more robust.
Optional: Consider adding eager image preloading or skeletons for testimonial avatars (Unsplash) to avoid mild perceived flicker on slow networks.
Code quality: Testimonials, Services and Process components are clean, well under 700 LOC; AnimatePresence usage with key={i} is correct.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Full UI verified on desktop (1440x900) and mobile (390x844). All requested data-testids exist and work: hero-primary-cta, hero-secondary-cta, services-mobile-slider, process-mobile-slider, why-feature-0..5, portfolio-filter-all/ecommerce/saas/website/branding, portfolio-card-0..5, testimonial-prev/next/quote, faq-item-0..5, pricing-cta-growth, contact-submit, contact-success. Earlier false-negative on testimonial cycling was a test-script issue (stale node ref due to AnimatePresence remount); re-tested with re-locator and confirmed all 3 quotes cycle correctly. Static contact form correctly does NOT hit any API.
rca of the issue: No production bugs. Initial test reported (a) portfolio filter not changing count and (b) testimonials not cycling — both turned out to be test-script issues: (a) generic CSS selector matched non-portfolio nodes; using data-testid^='portfolio-card' shows correct filtering (6→2→2). (b) Captured an element handle before AnimatePresence remounted the node; re-querying via page.locator each click confirms cycling works as designed.
